## Why restriction preserves the local contract

The checker infers the retained set directly from the old and new binary port
labels. It does not trust the transformation's mapping receipt. The eight
removed old canonical indices are 0, 13, 22, 35, 40, 51, 54, and 119.

It compares every operation of A, B, the target preconditioner, dirty
compensation, the center cut, and full-frame cleanup under the resulting
register map. Exactly eight operations disappear: each is a unit coordinate
shear from a removed source into its own removed target. No other operation
reads or writes any removed register. The scalar word therefore splits as
the direct sum of those eight independent shears and the retained word.

The retained word is independently replayed over exact rational numbers in
both orientations. Each orientation has 25242 literal events and 19816 scalar
macros. All 784 independent input columns have the required shear endpoint;
all source and helper rows return, and every private center is cleared.
The checker also follows each actual frame label and nested recursive
transition. It checks all entry and exit adapters and the placement of every
residual wrapper around the complete invocation.

Every retained frame is literally unchanged. Every residual-wrapper recipe
used by the 112-port word equals its corresponding recipe in the original
checked word. The wrapper is an identity on its declared spectator factor
and a normalized residual transform on the same local coordinates as before.
Neither statement depends on the presence of the eight discarded source and
target rows. The puncture introduces no stronger Lemma A or common-label
assumption: it instantiates the same interfaces on fewer data rows, using
the same local frames, scalar coefficients, and normalized wrappers.

## Why the global restriction is compatible with hosting

For each retained port, the four-pair data controller uses precisely its
original port chart. The independent checker constructs the 73-dimensional
orthogonal basis directly as a binary transvection of the standard basis and
checks its Gram matrix. The retained port labels are a subset of the original
labels, so their controller phase recipes and endpoint translations retain
their original meaning.

The order of the 72 complete invocations is independently reconstructed as
the increasing order of `(7*stage + 6*replica, stage, replica)`. The checker
expands the original controller events and measures each pending interval
between the previous actual local or bridge touch and the pending child.
This includes individual bridge touches rather than using stage endpoints as
a proxy for liveness.

All 40320 helper assignments lie strictly inside their owners' resulting idle
intervals. In each invocation, the 560 helper families are distinct and avoid
all 224 active data families. Thus all 784 owners of that invocation are
different. Each assigned residual occupies its prescribed actual pending
vectors. Its spectator coordinates lie outside that residual, and the full
73-vector chart is a permutation of the verified orthogonal basis. The
assignments use 3214 distinct actual charts.

The occupied pending vectors are pairwise disjoint within each owner interval.
They cover 349200 axes in total. The remaining original pending factors have
the exact histogram `{3:3354, 5:3270, 7:60, 48:230}`. Adding these literal
remainders to 72 copies of the independently counted local profile gives the
global histogram above. No residual is split between physical owners.

Induction over the controller events now uses the retained complete-invocation
contract: each invocation performs its data shear on arbitrary dirt, restores
the borrowed spectators, and leaves its stated residual on each idle owner.
The assigned factors and paid complement exactly complete the original
pending child before that family is touched again. The per-port controller
therefore retains its original endpoint on every surviving data family.

## Scope of the conclusion

This establishes the finite local restriction, owner chronology, concrete
charts, restored spectators, and complete recursive rank profile. Exact
Clifford phases, the finite scalar and routing invoice, and rational moment
and outer inequalities are also required in the assembled deliverable; this
review is an additional independent check of the changed finite ingredients.

The all-size compilation, common-label realization, precision and tape, and
analytic transfer conditions inherited from the source framework remain
conditions. Restricting the finite word does not prove those interfaces.

The approximately 4.77 percent global-kappa improvement certified by the
completed exact assembly is a structural advance for this round: both the
data-family count and the deficit change. The exact certified kappa, rather
than this rounded comparison, is the authoritative numerical conclusion.

## Reproduction

`audit_112_independent.py` accepts the original verified base directory, the
new local-artifact directory, the literal `OWNERS112.json.gz`, and an output
directory. Its `INDEPENDENT112-RAW-AUDIT.json` records input hashes and the
reconstructed results. It reads no optimization output except the literal
physical assignments that it verifies.
